website.label: Website
website.summary: The production website and key public routes were reachable during the 10 August check. Sites v53 is linked to the exact green GitHub main commit, and the required routes passed the HTTP, canonical redirect and security-header audit.

content.label: Published content
content.summary: The governed public release contains 177 published records. Amsterdam release v0.1.8 retired four WorldPride events whose official end dates had passed, while preserving their stable IDs and source history.

ios.label: iOS public distribution
ios.summary: Apple's public lookup service reports App Store version 1.3, released on 3 August 2026. GitHub Product CI and Xcode Cloud validation passed for the production release source on 9 August 2026.

businessForm.label: Business and feedback forms
businessForm.summary: Secure Supabase endpoints and Admin review views are active. The 10 August read-only check confirmed endpoint reachability and unauthenticated Admin redirects without creating a production record.

limitations: Endpoint reachability and invalid-input rejection were verified without creating a synthetic inquiry or feedback record.
